extDescription.message: Peek before you trust. One glance tells you if a site runs a PHP version exposed to PHP2Shell. Zero data collected.

noData.message: Nothing to peek at yet. Reload the page.

notPhp.message: No PHP in sight. Nothing to worry about here.

vulnNote.message: PHP2Shell is fixed in $1. Heads-up: some Linux distros patch without bumping the version number, so this is a strong hint, not proof.

eolNote.message: PHP 8.1 and older never got an official PHP2Shell fix. Only safe if the host backported it.

hiddenTitle.message: Runs PHP, keeps its version secret

hiddenNote.message: Can't tell from the outside. That's normal — and smart security.

footer.message: 100% passive. No requests, no tracking, no data. Open source.
